outcome: Ovarian reserve markers (day 3 FSH, antral follicle count, AMH)
Pulsatility index (PI) and resistance index (RI) of uterine and ovarian arteries
cohort: 49 women aged 21-36 years who underwent cesarean section, 25 of whom had bilateral UAL for intractable atonic PPH
finding: Bilateral uterine artery ligation (UAL) did not have a negative impact on ovarian reserve or ovarian blood supply in women who underwent the procedure for postpartum hemorrhage.
